_comment: REGENERATED by scripts/import_tnp_data.py from the unit sheet named in `source`; never edit it by hand. Correct the sheet and import again.

source.file: The New Project unit sheet v3.xlsx

salvage_yard.name: Salvage Yard
salvage_yard.ability: When a mechanical unit is destroyed in a battle you’re in, gain 1 material (max 3 times per battle)

intelligence_facility.name: Intelligence Facility
intelligence_facility.ability: After deployment, you may discard a card to examine half of a pile of units of your choice (rounded down). Then, you may redeploy one pile of your choice.

jeweler.name: Jeweler
jeweler.ability: You may now trade minerals for 2 gold each

harvesters.name: Harvesters
harvesters.ability: When harvesting, collect 2 resources (of the same kind) per worker

trader.name: Trader
trader.ability: You may now trade minerals for 3 materials each

converters.name: Converters
converters.ability: Discard a mineral card to draw a mineral card of a different kind

rapid_distillation.name: Rapid Distillation
rapid_distillation.ability: At the beginning of the production phase, discard a card to convert it into resources. You may use them in this production phase.

gathering_resources_under_fire.name: Gathering resources under fire
gathering_resources_under_fire.ability: At the end of each combat round, any force of workers that is unengaged and is not damaged may gather one resource that is in the embattled territory

aggressive_harvesting.name: aggressive harvesting
aggressive_harvesting.ability: You may bring the workers that in your base defense space to participate in this battle. They must be the first force in your battle line

research_and_development.name: Research and Development
research_and_development.ability: during infrastructure, you may place materials on this facility (max 6). During production, remove materials from this facility to to gain advanced technology cards (1 card for 3 materials)

automation.name: Automation
automation.ability: Gain a discount of 1 matearils per unit produced in this facility (to a minimum of 1)

surprisingly_valuable_side_effects.name: Surprisingly valuable side-effects
surprisingly_valuable_side_effects.ability: every time this facility produces, gain 1 gold

salvaging_under_fire.name: salvaging under fire
salvaging_under_fire.ability: When a mechanical unit is destroyed in this battle, gain 1 material (max 1 per round)

improved_carrier_capacity.name: Improved Carrier Capacity
improved_carrier_capacity.ability: Carrier Choppers have increased carrying capacity (see sheet)

advanced_robotics.name: Advanced Robotics
advanced_robotics.ability: Transformers can move like air units. After tactic cards are resolved, choose whether your transformers are air or armored

jet_engines.name: Jet Engines
jet_engines.ability: Jeeps become Mechanical and gain initiative -1

shields.name: Shields
shields.ability: Mechanical units ignore the first hit every round

enhancing_drugs.name: Enhancing drugs
enhancing_drugs.ability: Mercenaries get -1 initiative, +2 for all rolls. They die more easily: each hit kills 2 mercenaries

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.ability: If your Stealth Sniper force is not engaged, before the battle starts remove one enemy non-building unit (including tough) for each Stealth unit in the force

positioning.name: Positioning
positioning.ability: Jeeps and Tanks gain +1 when attacking forces they are engaged with (no penalty for adjacent columns, -1 for 2 away etc.)

exploding_smoke_shells.name: Exploding Smoke Shells
exploding_smoke_shells.ability: When a force of  Tanks hits, for every hit remove 2 infantry units from an adjacent Force (even tough)

cloaking.name: Cloaking
cloaking.ability: When a Transformer force is unengaged, it cannot be targeted.

super_cannon.name: Super Cannon
super_cannon.ability: After every round of battle, remove one enemy non-building unit (including tough) for every Fighter Bomber

medic_on_board.name: Medic on Board
medic_on_board.ability: Merceneries and Workers carried by Carrier Chopper gain Tough

aggressive_construction.name: Aggressive Construction
aggressive_construction.ability: Add up to 4 Base Defenses units (Mines, Rockets or Cannons). These units cannot retreat and cannot be moved from this territory defense spot (where they will be placed if you win)

bunkers.name: Bunkers
bunkers.ability: Choose one infantry force. That force has to sustain 1 hit as aromored before it could be attacked as usual

attached_mechanics.name: Attached mechanics
attached_mechanics.ability: During this battle, when a mechanical unit would take a hit - you may remove one worker from your base instead

tactical_maneuvering.name: Tactical Maneuvering
tactical_maneuvering.ability: Break a force of 4 or more units into 2 forces

explosives.name: Explosives
explosives.ability: Stealth Snipers gain +4 vs. base defense or when targeting base

specialized_training.name: Specialized training
specialized_training.ability: Attached unit get +1 for all rolls

tactical_nuke.name: Tactical Nuke
tactical_nuke.ability: At the beginning of an opponent's production phase: destroy one Tech Facility, one Building Tech or one production facility (construction, upgrade and infrastructure). unspent resources on that facility is lost. Discard Tactical Nuke.

construction_crane.name: Construction Crane
construction_crane.ability: Gain a discount of 1 mineral per produced unit (to a minimum of 1)
